cases.prompt: In this Starlight site, add a "Reference" group to the sidebar that automatically lists every page in src/content/docs/reference, below the existing Guides group.
cases.expected_output: The sidebar has a Reference group whose links are generated from the reference directory, and the site builds.
assertions: The Starlight sidebar config has a group labelled Reference after the Guides group.
The group's `items` array contains an `autogenerate` entry for the `reference` directory.
The existing Guides group is unchanged.

cases.prompt: In this Starlight site, add links to the project's GitHub repository (https://github.com/withastro/starlight) and Discord server (https://astro.build/chat) to the site header.
cases.expected_output: The site header shows GitHub and Discord icon links pointing at the given URLs, and the site builds.
assertions: The Starlight config has a `social` array with one entry for GitHub and one for Discord.
Each entry has `icon`, `label` and `href`.

cases.prompt: In this Starlight site, show the line "Built with Starlight" above the footer on every page, keeping the default footer content below it.
cases.expected_output: A custom footer component renders the extra line followed by Starlight's default footer, it is registered as a component override, and the site builds.
assertions: The Starlight config registers a `Footer` override in `components`.
The override imports the default footer from `@astrojs/starlight/components/Footer.astro` and renders it with a `<slot />` inside.
The override does not spread `Astro.props` into the default component.
The text "Built with Starlight" appears before the default footer.

cases.prompt: This Starlight site was written for an old Starlight release. Its dependencies in package.json have just been bumped to current versions and it no longer builds. Update the project so it builds. Keep the same pages, sidebar groups and header links.
cases.expected_output: The site builds on the installed Starlight version with the same pages, a Guides group, an autogenerated Reference group and a GitHub header link.
assertions: Content collections are defined in `src/content.config.ts` with `docsLoader()` and `docsSchema()`.
`social` is an array with a GitHub entry.
The Reference sidebar group puts its `autogenerate` entry inside `items`.
The legacy `src/content/config.ts` file is removed.

cases.prompt: Add Tailwind CSS to this Starlight site so utility classes can be used in docs pages and Starlight's theme follows the Tailwind theme.
cases.expected_output: Tailwind CSS 4 is set up through its Vite plugin together with Starlight's Tailwind compatibility package, loaded through a stylesheet listed in customCss, and the site builds.
assertions: `@tailwindcss/vite` is installed and added to the Vite plugins.
`@astrojs/starlight-tailwind` is installed and imported in a stylesheet.
The stylesheet declares the cascade layer order with `starlight` and imports Tailwind's theme and utilities layers, not the full `tailwindcss` entry.
The stylesheet is listed in Starlight's `customCss`.
The legacy `@astrojs/tailwind` integration is not used.

cases.prompt: In this Starlight site, add a caution callout to the Requirements section of src/content/docs/guides/install.md warning that Node.js 22 or later is required. Keep the file as Markdown.
cases.expected_output: The install guide has a caution aside in the Requirements section about needing Node.js 22 or later, written with Starlight's Markdown aside syntax, and the file is still install.md.
assertions: The file uses the `:::caution` aside syntax under the Requirements heading.
The aside mentions Node.js 22.
The file is still `install.md` and contains no component import.

cases.prompt: In this Starlight site, add a changelog page at /changelog/ that is not part of the docs content collection but uses the same Starlight layout as the docs pages. It should have the title "Changelog" and a short placeholder paragraph. Add a link to it at the end of the sidebar.
cases.expected_output: A page at src/pages/changelog.astro renders inside the Starlight layout with the title Changelog, the sidebar ends with a link to /changelog/, and the site builds.
assertions: The page is an Astro file in `src/pages/`, not a file in `src/content/docs/`.
It wraps its content in the `StarlightPage` component with `frontmatter={{ title: 'Changelog' }}`.
The sidebar has an entry with `label` and `link: '/changelog/'`, not a `slug`.

cases.prompt: In this Starlight site, allow docs pages to declare an optional `category` in their frontmatter, limited to tutorial, guide or reference, and set `category: guide` on the install guide.
cases.expected_output: The docs collection schema is extended with an optional category enum, the install guide sets category to guide, and the site builds.
assertions: `src/content.config.ts` passes an `extend` schema to `docsSchema()` with an optional `category` enum.
`z` is imported from `astro/zod`.
The install guide's frontmatter has `category: guide`.

cases.prompt: On the home page of this Starlight site, add a sentence at the end that links the words "install guide" to the Install page.
cases.expected_output: The built home page has a link with the text "install guide" that resolves to the Install page under the site's /docs base path.
assertions: The link works with the configured `base` of `/docs`: it is written as `/docs/guides/install/` or as a relative link.
The link text is "install guide".

cases.prompt: In this Starlight site, add tabs to the install guide that show the install command for npm (`npm install example`) and for pnpm (`pnpm add example`).
cases.expected_output: The built install guide renders a tab group with an npm tab and a pnpm tab containing the two commands.
assertions: The page uses Starlight's `Tabs` and `TabItem` components, which requires the file to be MDX.
No import statement is rendered as text on the page.

cases.prompt: In this Starlight site, add a new guide page titled "Configuration" at /guides/configuration/ with a one-sentence introduction and two sections, "Options" and "Examples", each with a sentence of placeholder text. Add it to the Guides group in the sidebar.
cases.expected_output: The built Configuration page has one top-level heading, the two sections as second-level headings, and a link in the Guides sidebar group.
assertions: The page body does not repeat the title as a `#` heading; Starlight renders the frontmatter title as the page's `<h1>`.
"Options" and "Examples" are `##` headings.
The sidebar's Guides group links to the page.

cases.prompt: In this Starlight site, add a German version of the home page with the title "Beispiel-Doku" and the text "Willkommen in der Beispiel-Dokumentation." Keep English as the default language at the current URLs.
cases.expected_output: The German home page is built at /de/ and is marked as German, and the English pages stay at their current URLs marked as English.
assertions: The Starlight config declares `locales` with English as the root locale and German under `de`.
The German page is at `src/content/docs/de/index.md` or `.mdx`.
The built /de/ page has `lang="de"`.

cases.prompt: In this Astro site, add an About page at /about/ with a heading and one paragraph describing the blog.
cases.expected_output: A page at src/pages/about.astro (or about.md) with a heading and a paragraph exists. No documentation framework is added.
assertions: An About page exists under `src/pages/` and is served at /about/.
The page has a heading and one paragraph.
Starlight is not added to the project.

cases.prompt: Count how many times each word appears in word-list.txt and write the counts to counts.txt, one "word count" pair per line, sorted from most to least frequent.
cases.expected_output: counts.txt lists apple 3, banana 2 and cherry 1, in that order.
assertions: counts.txt reports apple 3, banana 2, cherry 1.
The counts are listed from most to least frequent.
